description_en: Queries the diagnostic results of an origin probing task
description_zh: 调用ListApplicationMonitorDetectResult接口查询源站探测任务的诊断结果
name: ListApplicationMonitorDetectResult

parameters.help_en: The region of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the origin probing task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range to query for the origin probing task. The value is a UNIX timestamp that represents the number of seconds elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 源站探测任务待查询时间段的起始时间。Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the time range to query for the origin probing task. The value is a UNIX timestamp that represents the number of seconds elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 源站探测任务待查询时间段的截止时间。Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: end_time

ApplicationMonitorDetectResultList.description_en: The diagnostic results of the origin probing task
ApplicationMonitorDetectResultList.description_zh: 源站探测任务的诊断结果信息

items.description_en: The diagnostic results of the origin probing task
items.description_zh: 源站探测任务的诊断结果信息

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) associated with the origin probing node
AcceleratorId.description_zh: 源站探测任务对应的全球加速实例ID

Content.description_en: The response content returned by the origin probing task diagnosis
Content.description_zh: 源站检测任务诊断返回的响应内容

Detail.description_en:
The description of the diagnostic result of the origin probing task.

All forward nodes work well.: No exceptions were detected.
Endpoint network error.: The origin server is abnormal. Check whether the origin server service is running properly.
Public network error.: A public network fault occurred, which typically refers to a network fault between the client and the acceleration area.
Ga internal error.: An internal fault occurred. For example, the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance encountered an exception when processing the request.
Ga has been deleted.: The current Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance has been deleted.
Ga state is not stable: The current Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance status is unstable, such as being configured.
Ga has no listener configuration.: The current Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance has no listener configuration.
Missing endpoint configuration.: The endpoint configuration is missing.
Missing acceleration region configuration.: The acceleration area configuration is missing.
Missing endpointgroup configuration.: The endpoint group configuration is missing
Detail.description_zh:
源站探测任务的诊断结果描述。

All forward nodes work well.：未发现异常。
Endpoint network error.：源站异常，需要排查源站业务是否正常运行。
Public network error.：公网错误，一般指客户端到加速地域的网络错误。
Ga internal error.：内部错误，例如，全球加速实例内部处理请求异常。
Ga has been deleted.：当前全球加速实例已经被删除。
Ga state is not stable：当前全球加速实例状态不稳定，例如处于配置中。
Ga has no listener configuration.：当前全球加速实例无监听配置。
Missing endpoint configuration.：缺少终端节点配置。
Missing acceleration region configuration.：缺少加速地域配置。
Missing endpointgroup configuration.：缺少终端节点组配置

DetectTime.description_en: The time when the origin probing task diagnosis ended
DetectTime.description_zh: 源站检测任务诊断结束时间

DiagStatus.description_en:
The diagnostic result of the origin probing task.

success: The origin probing task succeeded.

failed: The origin probing task failed
DiagStatus.description_zh:
源站探测任务的诊断结果。

success：源站探测任务成功。

failed：源站探测任务失败

ListenerId.description_en: The instance ID of the listener associated with the origin probing node
ListenerId.description_zh: 源站探测任务对应的监听实例ID

Protocol.description_en:
The network transmission protocol type of the listener.

tcp: TCP.

udp: UDP.

http: HTTP.

https: HTTPS.

Listeners that use the UDP protocol do not support probing
Protocol.description_zh:
监听的网络传输协议类型。

tcp：TCP协议。

udp：UDP协议。

http：HTTP协议。

https：HTTPS协议。

UDP协议类型的监听不支持探测

StatusCode.description_en: The error code returned by the origin probing task diagnosis
StatusCode.description_zh: 源站检测任务诊断返回的错误码

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the origin probing task

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. This is used for paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
